dialogue.galboss.reizein_tohka.greeting: You... are the one who disturbed my peace?
dialogue.galboss.reizein_tohka.warning: Since you're here, be prepared for the consequences.
dialogue.galboss.reizein_tohka.in_battle: This is no time for small talk!
dialogue.galboss.reizein_tohka.violation: Your conduct is out of line.
dialogue.galboss.reizein_tohka.phase2: Student council final directive, in effect.
dialogue.galboss.reizein_tohka.phase2_un: Second directive unlocked - school-wide verdict standing by.
dialogue.galboss.reizein_tohka.confineme: Confinement order - hold it right there.
dialogue.galboss.reizein_tohka.verdict: School-wide verdict. Those with demerits, step forward.
dialogue.galboss.tadasugawa_rei.warning: If you're going to stand in my way, don't blame me.

pet.galboss.chat.reizein_tohka.line.0: Are you here with a report too? ... If not, you may sit for a while.
pet.galboss.chat.reizein_tohka.line.1: Far fewer rule-breakers lately. So you have been helping.
pet.galboss.chat.reizein_tohka.line.2: I was not born fond of ordering people around. But without it, everyone gets hurt.
pet.galboss.chat.reizein_tohka.line.3: Stay by my side from now on... The council needs someone dependable.
pet.galboss.chat.tadasugawa_rei.line.0: ... Do you need something? If not, out of the way.
pet.galboss.chat.tadasugawa_rei.line.1: Your posture is better than last time. Keep it up.
pet.galboss.chat.tadasugawa_rei.line.2: Rules are not meant to bind people. They keep everyone from getting hurt.
pet.galboss.chat.tadasugawa_rei.line.3: You are one of the few... I would not shoot.
pet.galboss.chat.onabuta_ikuko.line.0: Oh? Want a match? I am always ready.
pet.galboss.chat.onabuta_ikuko.line.1: Nice stance! Again, and this time I go all out!
pet.galboss.chat.onabuta_ikuko.line.2: In a fight I am the truest version of myself. You are not afraid of that, are you?
pet.galboss.chat.onabuta_ikuko.line.3: Next time... let us fight until sunrise! Promise!

epitaph.galboss.preamble.1: Through the nostalgic river of our homeland, the Ayu, it flows.
epitaph.galboss.preamble.2: O seekers of the Golden Land, follow the current and find the key.
epitaph.galboss.start: "You have found the key, then. Let us begin."
epitaph.galboss.enrage: "The praise is done — rejoice, remaining offerings."
epitaph.galboss.revive: "The witch revives. Follow me — the Golden Land awaits."
epitaph.galboss.goldenland_missing: §eThe Golden Land dimension failed to load; the final battle continues in place.
epitaph.galboss.victory: "The journey ends. The Golden Land at last."
epitaph.galboss.seal.head: Head
epitaph.galboss.hint.knee: Your knees are gone — you cannot jump.
epitaph.galboss.hint.chest: Your chest is gone — you cannot raise a shield.
epitaph.galboss.hint.belly: Your belly is gone — you cannot eat.
epitaph.galboss.night.1: Night 1 — Offer six living sacrifices chosen by the key.
epitaph.galboss.night.2: Night 2 — The rest of you, tear apart the two who are close.
epitaph.galboss.night.3: Night 3 — The rest of you, praise my noble name.
epitaph.galboss.night.9: Night 9 — The witch revives. None shall survive.
epitaph.galboss.night.10: Night 10 — The journey ends. The Golden Land at last.
epitaph.galboss.night_name.2: Night 2 · The Two Who Are Close
redtruth.galboss.eighteen: There are eighteen of us here.
redtruth.galboss.gouge.head: Gouge. Out. The head.
redtruth.galboss.none_survive: Not a single one of you will survive.
redtruth.galboss.revive: The witch Beatrice revives, here and now.
redtruth.galboss.truth.1: On this island of Rokkenjima, besides these eighteen people, no human exists.
redtruth.galboss.truth.2: No one entered or left this room.
redtruth.galboss.truth.3: In this incident, no tricks, hidden passages, remote devices or poisons were used.
